question.text: Conflict of Interest at the Fund-Constituent level of a Cat III AIF includes:

answer.text: Employees not soliciting gifts or hard/soft commissions and putting client interests above their own

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook pp.49-50, Fund-Constituent Level conflicts require employees to act in the client's interest over their own personal interests and not to solicit any gifts or hard/soft commissions when representing the fund. The Trap: Daily investment logs and a NIFTY-only investment policy are not described as Fund-Constituent Level conflict controls in the workbook. Note: The "client interest first" and "no solicitation of gifts or hard/soft commissions" wording is taken directly from workbook pp.49-50.
